full_text_en:
Guo Song et al. — Armed Robbery of a Bank Cash Transport Vehicle

**Defendant: Guo Song**, male, 32 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Beijing, unemployed. In December 1989, he was sentenced to four years' imprisonment for rape; he was arrested on September 12, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Liu Ziyu, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Nong Zhibao**, male, 28 years old, Zhuang ethnicity, native of Guangxi, worker at the Xinhe Huaqiao Farm in Chongzuo County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. He was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Xue Yintang, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Zhang Jianguo**, male, 25 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Heilongjiang Province, unemployed. He was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Zhang Shousen, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Lin Gang**, male, 26 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Heilongjiang Province, unemployed. He was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Ji Xuequan, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Huang Minping**, male, 33 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Hunan Province, driver for Beijing Shouqi Industrial Co., Ltd. He was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Sun Tie, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Zhang Ying**, female, 25 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Liaoning Province, pharmacist in the Pharmacy Department of Beijing Hospital. She was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Zhang Youwei and Liu Mingming, lawyers at Zhongkai Law Firm.

**Defendant: Lu Xianqin**, male, 30 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Hebei Province, manager of Beijing Sailaide Food Co., Ltd. He was arrested on November 1, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Hao Huizhen, lawyer at Beijing Tianning Law Firm.

**Defendant: Zhao Jianguo**, male, 34 years old, Han ethnicity, native of Beijing, driver for Beijing Shouqi Industrial Co., Ltd. He was arrested on November 8, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Sun Dongqing, lawyer at Beijing Jingdu Law Firm.

The Branch of Beijing People's Procuratorate instituted a public prosecution with the Beijing First Intermediate People's Court, charging defendant Guo Song with robbery and theft; defendant Huang Minping with illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition, harboring, and harboring stolen goods; defendants Nong Zhibao, Zhang Jianguo, and Lin Gang with illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition; and defendants Zhang Ying, Lu Xianqin, and Zhao Jianguo with harboring.

The Beijing First Intermediate People's Court, after public trial, found the following facts:

**I.** Defendant Guo Song, together with Lu Xianzhou (alias Li Jiansheng, male, 33 years old, formerly a driver for Beijing Shouqi Industrial Co., Ltd., sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve in 1992 for theft, escaped from prison on February 18, 1994, shot and wounded by public security personnel while resisting arrest during the investigation of this case, died from excessive injuries despite medical treatment, and no longer subject to criminal prosecution according to law), planned a robbery and scouted the crime scene. On the evening of August 25, 1996, Guo and Lu, at Building 33, Enjili Residential Area, Haidian District, Beijing, by prying open the door and sawing off the lock, stole a dark blue Honda sedan belonging to Wang Weide, valued at over RMB 209,000. At approximately 9:00 a.m. on August 27, 1996, Guo Song, together with Lu Xianzhou, each carrying two pistols illegally purchased by Lu from defendants Nong Zhibao, Zhang Jianguo, and Lin Gang, drove to the vicinity of the Binhe Road Sub-branch of Beijing City Cooperative Bank, where they masked their faces and intercepted the sub-branch's Sanfeng brand cash transport vehicle and Santana brand escort car, intending to rob the cash boxes containing over RMB 1.3 million. Li Guochun, Yang Xiaodong, and other staff members of the sub-branch fought fiercely and were shot by Guo Song and Lu Xianzhou. Guo Song shot An Baoguo, the driver of the cash transport vehicle, in the lower jaw, and Yang Xiaodong in the left scapula and left clavicle, causing serious injuries to both. Lu Xianzhou shot Li Chao, an escort officer, in the back and waist, causing serious injury; he also shot Li Guochun in the back, injuring Li's liver, lungs, and other organs, causing him to die from hemorrhagic shock.

**II.** Between November 3 and 7, 1995, Lu Xianzhou and defendant Huang Minping, after prior planning, went to Heihe City, Heilongjiang Province, carrying cash. Lu purchased from defendants Zhang Jianguo and Lin Gang two Qinghua SPO35 5.6mm small-bore sport pistols and over 100 rounds of ammunition for RMB 30,000, with Zhang Jianguo and Lin Gang profiting over RMB 15,000. Lu Xianzhou used the firearms purchased on this occasion to carry out two robberies: on December 13, 1995, at Building R, Huiyuan Apartment, Yayuncun, Beijing, robbing the Beijing Red Star City Credit Cooperative; and on August 27, 1996, near the Binhe Road Sub-branch of Beijing City Cooperative Bank, causing particularly serious consequences. Lin Gang surrendered himself to the Heihe City Public Security Bureau of Heilongjiang Province on October 11, 1996.

Between December 1995 and January 1996, Lu Xianzhou twice went to Pingxiang City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, and purchased from defendant Nong Zhibao for RMB 25,000 one Polish-made 1971-type 9mm micro submachine gun, one 9mm pistol, one Walther 7.65mm pistol, and one 7.62mm pistol, along with over 100 rounds of ammunition; Nong Zhibao profited over RMB 25,000. Lu Xianzhou, alone or together with defendant Guo Song, used the firearms purchased on this occasion to carry out three robberies: on February 8, 1996, in front of the Ganshuiqiao Sub-branch, Chaoyang Sub-branch, Beijing Branch, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, at Building 15, Area 4, Anhuili, Chaoyang District, Beijing; on June 3, 1996, near the Beijing Haidian Sub-branch, China Construction Bank, at No. 96 Zhichun Road, Haidian District, Beijing; and on August 27, 1996, near the Binhe Road Sub-branch of Beijing City Cooperative Bank, causing particularly serious consequences. The above firearms and some ammunition have been recovered.

**III.** On February 18, 1994, Lu Xianzhou escaped from prison and sought out defendant Huang Minping. Huang Minping hid Lu Xianzhou in the Crown taxi he drove and provided Lu with clothing and searched for a hiding place. Zhao Jianguo, knowing that Lu Xianzhou was a serious criminal who had escaped from prison, still provided him with over RMB 500.

On February 19, 1994, defendant Huang Minping contacted defendant Zhang Ying to find a hiding place for Lu Xianzhou. Zhang Ying informed defendant Lu Xianqin (Lu Xianzhou's younger brother) of Lu Xianzhou's escape. Lu Xianqin, through another person, found a temporary shelter in the basement of a teaching building at Beijing Second Foreign Language Institute, and Zhang Ying took Lu Xianzhou there to hide; Lu Xianqin provided Lu Xianzhou with over RMB 1,000.

Between March and October 1994, defendant Zhang Ying successively rented or borrowed houses for Lu Xianzhou to hide in at Jiuxianqiao, Heping Street, Jintai Road, Anhua Xili, and other locations in Chaoyang District, Beijing. During this period, defendant Lu Xianqin provided Lu Xianzhou with RMB 5,000; defendant Huang Minping repeatedly drove with Zhang Ying to move Lu Xianzhou to different hiding places.

**IV.** On the evening of September 2, 1996, defendant Guo Song, together with Lu Xianzhou, at Building 9, Puhui Beili, Haidian District, Beijing, by prying open the door and sawing off the lock, stole a beige Nissan sedan belonging to Tongxian Huaxiang Garment Factory, valued at over RMB 281,000. The sedan has been recovered.

In July 1995, defendant Guo Song, together with Lu Xianzhou, stole from a guesthouse of a certain unit of the People's Liberation Army one 14-inch Mudan brand color television, one Great Wall brand 2805 model computer, and one monitor of the same model.

**V.** In April 1996, defendant Huang Minping, knowing that the money in Lu Xianzhou's possession was proceeds from robbery, still accepted RMB 100,000 of it and used the stolen money to purchase stocks at Saige Securities Company. The stolen money has been recovered.

The above facts are confirmed by material evidence, documentary evidence, and witness testimony.

The Beijing First Intermediate People's Court held that defendant Guo Song, disregarding the law and failing to reform after completing his prison term, together with Lu Xianzhou, robbed a bank cash transport vehicle with firearms, causing multiple deaths and injuries. His conduct violated Article 150, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, constituting the crime of robbery. The nature of the crime was extremely vile, the circumstances and consequences were particularly serious, and the harm to society was extreme, warranting severe punishment. Guo Song, together with Lu Xianzhou, committed theft of an especially huge amount, and his conduct violated Article 152 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of theft. Given that he could confess to part of the theft, his punishment for the crime of theft is slightly mitigated. Guo Song committed a new crime within three years after completing his sentence, and in accordance with Article 61, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he is a recidivist and should be severely punished. Defendants Nong Zhibao, Zhang Jianguo, Lin Gang, and Huang Minping violated firearms control laws and regulations by purchasing firearms and ammunition for Lu Xianzhou, endangering public security. Their conduct violated Item (4) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security, constituting the crime of illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition. They caused particularly serious consequences, and the circumstances of the crime were especially serious, warranting severe punishment according to law. Lin Gang surrendered himself after committing the crime; in accordance with Article 63 of the Criminal Law, his punishment may be mitigated. Defendants Huang Minping, Zhang Ying, Lu Xianqin, and Zhao Jianguo, knowing that Lu Xianzhou was a serious criminal who had escaped from prison, still rented or borrowed hiding places or provided money and goods to help Lu Xianzhou evade legal sanctions. Their conduct violated Article 162, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of harboring. The circumstances of the crime were serious, warranting severe punishment according to law. Defendant Huang Minping, knowing that the money was the proceeds from Lu Xianzhou's robbery of a bank, still harbored it; his conduct violated Article 172 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of harboring stolen goods. Given that Huang Minping, while in custody, could provide relevant leads in this case, demonstrating meritorious conduct, his punishment is mitigated according to law. Defendants Guo Song and Huang Minping each committed multiple crimes; in accordance with Article 64 of the Criminal Law, they shall be subject to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. Accordingly, on December 19, 1996, the Beijing Intermediate People's Court ruled as follows:

1. Defendant Guo Song is convicted of robbery and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; he is convicted of theft and sentenced to fifteen years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for three years. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
2. Defendant Nong Zhibao is convicted of illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
3. Defendant Zhang Jianguo is convicted of illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
4. Defendant Lin Gang is convicted of illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition and sentenced to death, with a two-year reprieve, and deprivation of political rights for life.
5. Defendant Huang Minping is convicted of illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition and sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life; he is convicted of harboring and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for one year; he is convicted of harboring stolen goods and sentenced to three years' imprisonment. The combined sentence is life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life.
6. Defendant Zhang Ying is convicted of harboring and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for one year.
7. Defendant Lu Xianqin is convicted of harboring and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for one year.
8. Defendant Zhao Jianguo is convicted of harboring and sentenced to three years' imprisonment.

All stolen goods seized in this case are confiscated.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, defendants Nong Zhibao, Zhang Jianguo, Huang Minping, Zhang Ying, Lu Xianqin, and Zhao Jianguo appealed. Nong Zhibao appealed on the ground that the original judgment was factually erroneous and the sentence was too heavy; Huang Minping appealed on the ground that his role in the commission of the crime was minimal and that he had demonstrated meritorious conduct, requesting leniency; the other appellants also appealed to the Beijing High People's Court on the grounds that they were first-time offenders, their roles in the crime were minimal, they had a good attitude in admitting their guilt, and the original sentence was disproportionately heavy.

The Beijing High People's Court, after trial, held that the original court had fully considered the various circumstances raised in the appeals when making its judgments based on the facts, nature, circumstances, consequences, and individual culpability of each defendant's crimes. The original judgment was correct in conviction and application of law, the sentences were appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful, and it should be affirmed. Accordingly, in accordance with Article 189(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on March 21, 1997, the Beijing High People's Court ruled: the appeals are rejected and the original judgment is affirmed.

Pursuant to the Supreme People's Court's authorization for high people's courts to approve certain death penalty cases, the Beijing High People's Court approved the criminal judgments sentencing Guo Song to death for the combined crimes of robbery and theft, with deprivation of political rights for life; and sentencing Nong Zhibao and Zhang Jianguo to death for illegal sale and purchase of firearms and ammunition, with deprivation of political rights for life.
